chunks: Will be the day of woe for those
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Woe on that day' for the deniers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir is often linked to the concept of *Wail*, denoting a place of deep destruction or a cry of woe, emphasizing the spiritual ruin of those who stubbornly reject divine signs. It serves as a poignant reminder of the inevitable consequences of *Jahiliyyah* (ignorance) and denial, urging believers to maintain steadfastness in truth amidst societal skepticism.
